# Laloo

> Laloo (laloo.org) is a free web map that helps travelers find the nearest bathroom anywhere, with no app to download. It shows public restrooms, hand-picked spots and cafés, walking directions, drinking water, and short travel stories written by real people, not AI.

Key facts:
- Covers 186 cities with their own pages; the live map works worldwide using OpenStreetMap data plus places checked by the Laloo team.
- 12 languages, picked automatically from the phone's language. No account needed to use the map.
- Local businesses on the way can appear as red pins with a discount code. Paid listings are always labeled.
- Started in 2026 at a small shop on the Venice Beach boardwalk in Los Angeles, where visitors kept asking where the bathroom was.
- Contact: hello@laloo.org

## Main pages
- [Live map](https://laloo.org/): nearest bathroom from your location
- [All cities](https://laloo.org/cities/): public bathrooms city by city
- [Laloo Stories](https://laloo.org/stories/): travel stories by real people, with the places and bathrooms they mention
- [Rate a bathroom](https://laloo.org/rate/): two-tap ratings, checked before they appear
- [About](https://laloo.org/about/): how Laloo works
